title: The Name Written on Someone's Sketch
youtube_title: The Name Written on Someone's Sketch | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Hiding a dent does not make the dent untrue.
summary: At a kitchen table with jam, butter, and a shared pencil tin, Cosima is tangled up with a name written by accident on someone else's sketch and almost hides it. Cosima tells Ms. Okonkwo the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
